thread:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Detected surge of 502/504 from edge-proxy cluster us-west-2. Rolling 5m 5xx rate = 18% (baseline ~0.3%). Triggered at 21:12 UTC. Paging @sara (oncall). Metrics: https://metrics.redwood/edge/502s?range=5m

sara (oncall): ack — on it. What's the scope (regions/paths/customers)?

incident-bot: Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings primarily. Regions flagged: us-west-2 edge pool. Top error: 502 (upstream reset) and 504 (timeout). Top clients by volume: client-a (22%), client-b (15%), unknown bots (10%).

jess (sre): any recent edge deploys or config changes in last 20m?

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: edge-proxy-config v12 -> v13 at 21:08 UTC (commit 7f3c2a). No canary.

miguel (infra): looks like the spike lines up with that config change. I'm seeing an increase in `connection reset` and `upstream timeout` in the proxy logs. Possible upstream connection reuse or keepalive exhaustion.

sara (oncall): ok, first mitigation: throttle client-a and client-b to preserve capacity, and add a short-term upstream retry. Applying rate-limit rule now.

sara (oncall): ran quick curl from inside edge: ```
curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" https://edge-us-west-2.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
* Connected to edge-us-west-2.internal (10.0.5.7) port 443 (#0)
* recv failed: Connection reset by peer
* Closing connection 0
{"error":"upstream reset"}
```

miguel (infra): grabbing proxy logs snippet: ```
[21:11:55] proxy us-west-2: proxy_upstream_reset: peer="10.10.2.45:443" code=ECONNRESET
[21:12:03] proxy us-west-2: upstream_timeout route="/v1/generate" peer="10.10.2.46"
```

jess (sre): If config v13 changed `keepalive_pool_size` or `max_connections`, that could explain it. MIGUEL — can you diff the config and point out changed fields?

miguel (infra): diff: v12->v13: changed `keepalive_timeout` 60->120, `max_idle_conns_per_host` 100->20, enabled `connection_reuse=true`. That `max_idle_conns_per_host` drop looks suspicious.

oliver (platform): rolling back to v12 seems safest short-term while we investigate. Any objections?

sara (oncall): agree. Initiating rollback to v12 now. Command: `edgectl config rollback --env us-west-2 --from v13 --to v12 --reason "502 spike"`

deploy-bot: Rollback job started: job id rb-2158004321-1. Expect ~30s to propagate to all edge proxies in us-west-2.

customer-ops: quick heads-up — we've received two high-sev support pings: CID-1234 (mobile app) and CID-5678 (partner integration). Both report large request failures since 21:10 UTC. I'm creating tickets and adding status updates.

sara (oncall): watching metrics — 60s after rollback started, 5xx rate dropping to 9%. Still elevated but trending down.

ops-bot: Canary health checks: 90s after rollback completion: OK=98, 502=1.2%, 504=0.3% (rollout completed to primary pool).

jess (sre): good. Next: keep the rollback in place, mark v13 config for detailed review (focus on `max_idle_conns_per_host`). We'll open a post-deploy test to validate connection pooling limits.

miguel (infra): capturing additional data: backend nginx showed increased keepalive closure under load — looks like the proxy was closing idle connections faster than expected with lower idle pool, causing upstream to see connection churn and resets. Repro steps queued.

sara (oncall): mitigation summary for handoff: 1) Rolled back edge-proxy config v13->v12. 2) Applied emergency rate-limits to top noisy clients. 3) Opened infra ticket (INFRA-5421) to investigate connection pooling and to add pre-deploy check for `max_idle_conns_per_host`. 4) Notified customer-ops; two customers impacted, support tickets created.

sara (oncall): error rate now ~0.8% (near baseline). Leaving incident channel and handing off to @oliver (platform) for follow-up and RCA. My oncall window ends in 30m.

oliver (platform): taking it. I'll coordinate with miguel/jess on RCA and remediation. Please post the rollback job id and any logs you saved.

sara (oncall): rollback job id rb-2158004321-1; saved proxy logs at s3://redwood-incident-logs/2158004321/proxy/*. Tarball linked: https://s3.redwood/2158004321-logs.tar.gz.

customer-ops: updating affected customers with ETA for full RCA (48h). Also flagging for possible credit based on SLA.

incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> service health recovering. Severity: P2 (customer impact limited after rollback). Next steps: RCA assigned to INFRA-5421; postmortem DRAFT due in 72h.

sara (oncall): thanks team — handing channel over. :white_check_mark:
summary: Edge proxy 502/504 spike in us-west-2 after config v13; rollback to v12 mitigated; oncall handoff to platform for RCA
